title: Man gunned down during wake of father in Tacloban City

blocks.text: TACLOBAN CITY, Philippines — A 22-year-old glass installer was shot dead while his family and relatives were attending the wake of his father in Barangay 92, Apitong, this city, early on Friday, Nov. 20, police said. The victim, identified only as Jason, was declared dead at around 5:49 a.m. at the Tacloban City Hospital, several hours after the shooting incident at about 2:30 a.m. Police identified the suspect only as Garry, 26, a resident of Tacloban City, who was arrested following a follow-up investigation and interviews with witnesses at the scene.
